title: Coast Guard rescues 5 stranded in Houston floodwaters (546164)
description: A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Houston rescues five people from floodwaters in a southeastern Houston neighborhood, Aug. 27, 2017. Coast Guard, Texas Air National Guard, Customs and Border Protection and other federal, state and local agencies are have been conducting urban rescues in the greater Houston area since Saturday. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Corinne Zilnicki/Released)
